summary: Play 36 original Sudoku puzzles with pencil notes, undo and saved games.
release_notes: The menu keeps all its buttons on screen in landscape at the largest text size. Buttons in a row are now the same width, headings are set in a serif, and dialogs show their two answers side by side.
page_description: Play 36 original Sudoku puzzles across three difficulties, each with exactly one solution. Pencil notes, undo, checking preference, and saved games survive reopening.
